review: Heishou Faust is similar to the Mao Branch IDs in that she gains a lot of haste and is a very stable applicator of Rupture through Deathrite. First things first, alongside Deathrite [Haste], Heishou Faust has Deathrite [Fissure], which is inflicted on her Skill 3-1. What it does is that when Rupture is triggered while the target has Deathrite, it inflicts Bind next turn. When the effect activates, if the target is to gain 3 or more Bind next turn, 2 Stacks of Deathrite [Fissure] will be lost instead of gaining Bind. When the stack reaches 0, the target will take Gluttony damage equal to Rupture Potency on self. Additionally, thanks to Heishou Faust’s passive, when the Deathrite [Fissure] Stack drops to 0 and expires, the target will gain Mark of Decay, which will be removed at Turn End. This status makes the target take +10% more damage from Gluttony Skills and +10% more damage from Deat
